audit.why: Lane difficulty is stated (TRICKY, 7/10) and grounded: Lux's range/root deny Leona's only engage tool for most of laning.
Power spikes (level 2 E-Q, level 6 Solar Flare/Final Spark, first item, 2+ items) are already named with real ability names and are kept.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart (phases[0-6].side) is the generic placeholder 'Skill' on every row, and the matching .why text describes Leona winning each stage, while the content layer (win[0-6]) already says 'Lux' wins all seven stages and packet.winRate (54.26% for Leona) plus the lint defect flag the disagreement.
audit.why: Lux's Q (Light Binding, 10s CD) roots Leona's E-dash and her poke (Lucent Singularity) out-ranges Leona for the entire laning phase through 2 items; Final Spark (R) threatens burst on any commit at level 6+. There is no kit-grounded reason for Leona to win any of the seven listed stages in this matchup's laning/skirmish sense, so the side column should agree with the already-correct content win[N] column (Lux) rather than the reverse.
audit.corrected: phases[0-6].side set to 'Lux' with matching .why rewritten to state the Lux-favored reason at each stage (root/poke, then Final Spark burst, then poke-lead scaling).
